The Hormuz impasse remains the oil driver. Live search (coverage dated Oct 19-20) has Brent near $109.6-110 after touching $110 for the first time since May, Houthi claims against Saudi energy sites and a reported Hormuz mine strike, Kpler putting crude flows through the region near 8.5 mb/d over seven days against more than 20 mb/d the week before, and President Trump rejecting Iran's seven-day proposal to reopen the strait. A Friday order waiving some sanctions and tariffs on Russian energy exports is pulling the other way. These come from secondary outlets, so the levels are uncertain. Carried calendar, not re-verified: FOMC decision Oct 28, NFP Nov 6, CPI Nov 10. A Hormuz reopening deal is the main de-escalation path; more attacks keep the inflation input live.

thesis.observe: BTC $81,433 (-1.6% 24h), 0.3% below the $81,699 ETF cost basis and 2.9% above the True Market Mean ($79,158). hl-cycles (about 10 h stale): mild risk-off since Oct 19, allocation 33%, 2 of 6 stress conditions on (STH-SOPR below 1, ETF 7d outflow), Compass 47 (Neutral), Macro lens 30 (Restrictive). thesis.infer: Price down with OI edging up and funding at the floor reads as a mild lean short rather than a crowded move, so there is little to squeeze and little to unwind. Contracting stablecoin supply, a Restrictive Macro lens and a risk-off label disagree with the rising weekly structure and a Neutral Compass: the market is holding a level without new leverage against a tightening backdrop. Consensus is pricing a hold on Oct 28; we read persistent oil strength as keeping the hawkish side of that meeting live.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC chops between the True Market Mean ($79.2K) and the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close back above $81.7K with OI recovering would soften the risk-off read, while a daily close below it is hl-cycles' stated invalidation and keeps the risk-off label. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below $79.2K could put the STH cost basis ($74.4K, about 9% below) in play. Second tail case (low-confidence): a hold with dovish language and oil below $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and BTC extend higher. Consensus is pricing a hold; we read the risk as skewing to a hawkish surprise.
